title: Shuai Ma
text:
Research Interests
Housing capitalization of flood risk and mitigation investment; distributional and environmental-justice effects of climate-adaptation policy in flood-prone communities; land-use regulation and real estate markets; causal inference and urban informatics, including GIS and explainable machine learning, for policy evaluation.

title: Shuai Ma
text:
Research Papers and Writing Samples
Hazard or Amenity? Flood Risk, Waterway Proximity, and Neighborhood Inequality in Housing Prices 2025–Present
Sole-authored PhD writing sample; empirical study of Pierce County, Washington

Examines how flood risk, waterway proximity, and neighborhood inequality are capitalized into housing prices using 47,763 single-family sales linked to parcel, FEMA flood-risk, and neighborhood data.
Estimates hedonic regression models with tract-clustered standard errors and conducts spatial analysis to evaluate whether flood-risk effects are bundled with waterfront amenity.
Uses flood-income-waterway typologies, machine-learning models, and SHAP interpretation to motivate a future causal research agenda on flood-mitigation investment and distributional effects.

Strategic Management’s Foundational Silence 2025–Present
First-author coauthored manuscript in revision with Rubina Mahsud and Greg Prussia; developed from a 2020 Strategic Management Society conference proposal

Built and cleaned a corpus of 3,202 Strategic Management Journal articles and applied classical natural language processing (NLP) methods, local open-source large language models (LLMs), and cloud-based LLMs to analyze the field’s dominant vocabulary.
Develops the concept of “foundational silence” to argue that poverty, war, disease, hunger, homelessness, and related human concerns should be treated as central social contexts rather than peripheral externalities.

title: Shuai Ma
text:
Selected Analytical Projects
Sponge City and Low-Impact Development Technical Research and Application 2017
Research leader; led a two-person, three-month applied research effort on stormwater adaptation

Synthesized sponge-city policies, Low Impact Development (LID) technologies, and multi-city case materials into technical guidance for runoff control, rainwater reuse, water-quality treatment, and urban flood-risk reduction.
Evaluated permeable paving, green roofs, bioswales, rain gardens, wetlands, detention facilities, and runoff-control scenarios using catchment analysis, water-balance calculations, and stormwater simulation outputs.

Empirical Analysis of Guangzhou Residential Rental Markets 2021
Sole-authored applied econometric project using scraped public rental-listing data

Collected and cleaned approximately 3,000 publicly available online rental listings and modeled Guangzhou rent variation using structural housing attributes, rental type, floor information, and district-level location indicators.
Applied OLS regression, stepwise variable selection, VIF/kappa multicollinearity diagnostics, PCA, and exploratory clustering to evaluate key rental-price determinants.

Serviced Apartment and Long-Term Rental Housing Sector Studies 2016; 2021
Sole-authored mixed-methods housing-market research using field visits, web-scraped data, R, and Python

Conducted field visits to dozens of serviced-apartment projects and compiled public online listing data to compare rents, occupancy, tenant profiles, product layouts, amenities, operators, and location patterns.
Analyzed 987 Guangzhou serviced-apartment listings using descriptive statistics, cross-tabulation, chi-square tests, and tree-based feature-importance models to evaluate brand, district, accessibility, and unit-level rent drivers.

Comparative Policy Study of New Industrial Land (M0) in the Greater Bay Area 2021
Sole-authored study of land-use regulation, industrial redevelopment, and zoning-like reform

Compared M0 land-use policies across Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Dongguan, Foshan, Huizhou, Zhongshan, and Zhuhai, examining industry eligibility, site-selection rules, FAR requirements, subdivision and transfer restrictions, land tenure, and performance monitoring.
Synthesized national, provincial, and municipal policy documents to evaluate how regulatory design supports industrial upgrading while limiting speculative real-estate conversion of industrial land.

Highest and Best Use (HBU) Optimization for Business-Park Development 2021
Initiated and led internal real estate analytics study using market research, regulatory constraints, and Python linear programming

Surveyed 11 competing business-park projects in Foshan to parameterize 16 candidate product typologies, including multi-floor manufacturing buildings, detached warehouses, and independent offices.
Formulated a Python PuLP optimization model to maximize gross development value under FAR, building-height, plot-coverage, and green-space-ratio constraints.
Tested alternative product-mix scenarios to compare value maximization with market absorption, translating HBU analysis into a data-driven development strategy.

Jiangsu Provincial Low-Carbon Urban System Strategy 2011
Core ARUP project-team member; early-career foundation in regional carbon accounting and low-carbon planning

Contributed to an IPCC-based carbon-audit framework linking urban-system planning with activity-data and emissions-factor methods across land use, buildings, industry, transportation, water, waste, ecological space, and alternative energy.
Supported province-scale baseline emissions estimation for Jiangsu’s urban system, translating carbon-accounting results into planning-relevant evidence for low-carbon strategy and policy design.

title: Shuai Ma
text:
Technical Skills
Programming and Data Analysis: Python (pandas, NumPy, GeoPandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, SHAP, PuLP, Matplotlib, web scraping); R (tidyverse, ggplot2/GGally, R Markdown); SQL.
Statistical and Econometric Methods: hedonic price modeling, OLS regression with clustered standard errors, model selection and diagnostics, PCA, clustering, and scenario analysis.
Machine Learning and Model Interpretation: tree-based models (decision trees, random forests), feature-importance analysis, and SHAP-based model interpretation.
Text and AI-Based Analysis: natural language processing (NLP), keyword-extraction methods, corpus construction, and large language models (LLMs), including open-source and cloud-based models.
GIS, Spatial, and Environmental Analysis: QGIS; spatial data processing, floodplain mapping, spatial autocorrelation, catchment and water-balance analysis, stormwater simulation outputs, and IPCC-based carbon accounting.
Research Workflow and Reporting: Quarto, LaTeX, Zotero (Better BibTeX), Git/GitHub, and Microsoft Excel.

title: Shuai Ma
text:
Professional Experience
Founder & Principal Researcher, Beamlinked Consulting Co., Ltd. 2023–Present

Founded an independent consulting and research practice focused on urban development, real estate markets, sustainable planning, and policy-oriented analytics.
Leads applied research and advisory work on business-park development, housing and real estate markets, land-use policy, and climate-related planning issues.
Develops AI-assisted research workflows, including diffusion-model applications for spatial-design exploration and customized language-model tools for sustainability disclosure review.

Vice Director, Property Asset Management, Ping An Group 2020–2023

Directed planning and design review across the real estate portfolio, including new-town projects and business parks, and contributed to company-wide planning and design guidelines.
Served on the internal research think tank, producing regular analytical reports for senior management on real estate markets, urban policy, infrastructure investment, and industrial-park planning.
Participated as a core ESG committee member, reviewing project sustainability performance and supporting LEED v4.1 O+M Platinum certification work for the Ping An International Finance Center.
Delivered internal professional training as a company-certified lecturer, communicating planning, real estate, and sustainability knowledge to professional audiences.

Director, Planning and Development, China Fortune Land Development 2017–2018

Directed town planning, urban design, land-use planning, statutory-planning coordination, and water-green-system planning for two public-private-partnership development districts of roughly 3,200 acres each.
Co-developed a group-wide green-development guideline adopted as a standard for new real estate development projects.

Project Manager, AtkinsRéalis / Atkins 2013–2017

Led planning and design teams across town planning, master planning, business and industrial parks, commercial complexes, tourism districts, and sustainability-oriented urban development projects.
Directed applied research on microclimate analysis, building physics, environmental simulation, and performance-based design methods, including CFD, PMV, whole-building energy simulation, and radiation analysis.
Served as an internal sustainability consultant, helping project teams apply LEED, BREEAM, WELL, China Green Building Label, EEWH, and CASBEE standards.

Urban Planner, Arup 2011–2013

Contributed as a project-team member to low-carbon planning, urban design, waterfront development, transit-oriented development, and regional planning projects.
Supported carbon-audit, green-building economics, low-carbon ecological planning, and cross-scalar planning research for department-level studies and publications.
Supported a National Basic Research Program study and contributed research materials later incorporated into two published department-led books: Low-Carbon Ecological Space: Rethinking Cross-Dimensional Planning Methods and Study on the Economics of Green Buildings in China.

Assistant Planner, Tongji University Urban Planning and Design Institute 2007–2009

Supported regional planning, comprehensive urban development planning, tourism planning, historic-district design, and industrial-park planning projects.

title: Research

Housing & Real Estate
My work explores housing affordability and real estate dynamics under climate and economic uncertainty.
Key topics: - Housing supply constraints and zoning
- Climate risk pricing in real estate markets
- Housing policy evaluation
